content: We need number of CH3 groups in the compound. But we don't have the compound given. Possibly need to get NMR spectra to infer? But we don't know which compound. Maybe the sample is implicit: the system has a sample at hand. We can get proton NMR to see methyl signals. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool. That will give spectrum string. Then we can count methyl peaks (triplet around 0.9 ppm etc). Could also use carbon NMR to see methyl carbons (~10-30 ppm). Probably easiest: get proton NMR. Use tool.
